'''Dengar876 I made a Dark Deal after freezing Han!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dengar876]]
* '''Published:''' 18 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / Cloud City Occupation|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor CCT Dengar876 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Note: This deck is only using cards Thru Coruscant

Using a lot of Retrieval playing with Carbon Chamber Testing and Dark Deal

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Note: This deck is with cards only thru Coruscant, do not tell me to add Theed Palace or Refelection 3 cards!!!!!!

This deck has 2 goals, getting Jabba's Prize to Audience Chamber and getting Dark Deal Down.

Against a Space deck:

Start with Combat Response in place of All Wrapped Up. Then get Lando down, in order to prevent General Calrissian to be deployed, pull him using  Cloud City: Security Tower's text and move to the docking bay and put him in a ship in order to prevent replacement. Use the Bounty Hunters in their ships, and use the Outer Rim Scouts in Jabba's Space Crusier and sack them for attrition. A good space deck will be tough to beat but if you can stall them in space long enough to get dark deal down you should be fine. Get Jabba's Prize over as fast as you can and then you can throw down Dark Deal. Once you get Dark Deal you can drain like crazy! A good space deck will be tough to beat but if you can stall them in space long enough to get dark deal down you should be fine.

Against a Ground deck:

To get Jabba's Prize to Audience Chamber use whatever bounty hunters you get armed with the weapons you have, once you get 2 weapons or more you can get him to Audience Chamber. You can use Lando to add a lot of power using the interrupts A Real Hero and Furry Fury. With Furry Fury all the need to have is Chewie cause u already have Han, and A Real hero will always work! As soon as you get a Twi'lek Advisor pull Combat Response so you can throw your ships down on  Cloud City: East Platform and use Outer Rim Scouts as Pilots. Once you get Jabba's Prize down, then you can throw down Dark Deal. Move Jabba's Prize to the Jabba's Palace: Dungeon and retrieve 2 force then move him back. If you can get All wrapped up down, it will force them to either let a guy of theirs get captured, who you bring to the dungeon and get 2 force, or lose another guy that didn't get hit. This will amplify your power. This is a pretty straight forward deck, get bounty hunters use weapons and shoot them while moving to audience chamber and then getting Dark Deal down. If you get Dark Deal and Skum and Villany down, you aliens and independent starships (all of them in this deck) are deploy -1, retrieve 2 force when you initiate a battle, and at cloud city sites your total power is +4. Your objective will allow you to retrieve 1 force every turn when fliped.

A great combo is to forfit Vibro-Axe as attrition and then next turn snoova's text will allow you to pull it back out!

Note: This deck is with cards only thru Coruscant, do not tell me to add Theed Palace or Refelection 3 cards!!!!!!
